title: feat(qa): retest-owed reader, touched:SHA selector and the standing regression cadence
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D27iKcauY7daF8J3vRY9Ucx)_

Fixes #27383

## What changes

1. **`scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` (new, read-only).** Lists the closed issues that carry a `QA-source: #RECORD · area.item · clause` line and closed after the subject commit time of the newest `qa-run` record that judged that item. Each row names the item, its fix card(s), the record that last judged it, and whether a later record re-judged it. `--json`, `--as-of ISO` (replays the past), `--repo`, and an offline `--self-test` (57 assertions in 9 batteries, with the battery roster and floor copied from qa-rollup). It writes nothing to GitHub.
   - A record judges an item only when its title selector is that item with a judged count, or a body line names the item with a pass/partial/fail word and no not-run word. Records that only *name* an item are shown as `unconfirmed: #N names it`, so a missed judgment errs toward "owed", never toward "re-judged".
   - `smoke:npm-VERSION · CELL` locators are re-judged by the next `smoke:npm-*` record.
   - Nothing is dropped: malformed `QA-source:` lines, unrecognized locators and cross-repo records are listed under **Not read** with the reason. Cards closed `not_planned`/`duplicate` are listed under **Closed without a fix**.
   - Time is three-valued. A record whose subject sha cannot be resolved makes the row **Unknown**, not owed and not re-judged.
   - Endpoints are repo-scoped only (closed issues since the oldest record, `GET /repos/…/commits/SHA` for subject times). The listing follows the `next` cursor carried onto the `/repos` path, because the `/repositories/ID` form of that link answers 403 from a cloud session and `page=100` answers 422.
2. **`touched:SHA` selector in `scripts/checklist-select.mjs`.** Selects the runnable items whose `source[]` paths or `automated.ref` files changed in `SHA..HEAD`, from `git diff --no-renames --name-only SHA HEAD`.
   - The `#symbol` anchor and trailing prose are cut, and `dir/{a,b}.ts` brace lists are expanded.
   - A cited path matches a changed path that holds it as a whole run of `/` segments. That covers the same path, a path under a cited directory (prefix match), or a longer path ending in it. A bare basename matches only for a source-file extension.
   - The CLI refuses a malformed or unfetched sha with exit 2 and the fetch remedy, and names citations whose file no longer exists.
   - It is listed in the header's selector table and in the skill's §0 table. The self-test battery floor goes from 31 to 45 cases (14 new, each load-bearing).
3. **`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`**, with the cadence stated as the maintainer chose it:
   - a new §6 "standing regression", covering the weekly run on `main` HEAD (one `qa-run` record per selector: retest-owed list, `touched:` the previous weekly subject, `priority:P0`, `surface:api`, with Supersede keeping at most one open per selector), the post-publish `smoke:npm-VERSION` in the shape of the previous smoke record, where its fix cards are re-judged, and the retest-owed reader;
   - §5 gains a fourth retest trigger and keeps "hand-feel reruns are not triggers";
   - verification retest is now "not the fifth trigger";
   - the creation of the scheduled tasks stays with the dispatching PM session, not repo code.
4. **`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`**: the checklist-test ceiling moves **246 → 256**. Ruling of record: **#27377 comment 6501246005** (the maintainer's four options and 「这些都应该写到 checklist skills 中」, verbatim). Measured delta: **+10** = 14 ruled lines (§0 `touched:` row 1, trigger 4 1, §6 12) less 4 repaid by rejoining four §5 wraps that had broken mid-word. No line over 120 bytes, and the widest table row is unchanged at 221.

RUNNER.md is unchanged; nothing in it needed to move.

## Why

QA-extracted fix cards land between release candidates. Nothing listed which checklist items those landings left un-re-judged, so §5 trigger 2 depended on memory. `touched:` gives the weekly run an incremental pool. The maintainer ruled the cadence on #27377 and asked for it to be written into the checklist skill.

## Verification

**Anchor proof on #25807** (live, 214 API reads, 0 writes; corpus: 160 `qa-run` records, 136 with a canonical title; 17,967 issues scanned since 2026-08-11; 171 cards with a `QA-source:` line; 32 of 32 subject shas resolved):

- `--as-of 2026-10-29T00:00:00Z` (before wave 3) gives 20 owed rows. All 22 fix cards the card names are accounted for:
  - **16 owed**: #25934, #26452, #26453, #26459, #26461, #26462, #26463, #26465, #26474, #26477, #26478, #26479, #26480 (12 item rows; `ux-conventions.write-feedback` carries two cards) and #26630, #26631, #26632 (`smoke:npm-18.2.0` cells D3, C3, F5).
  - **5 under Not read**: #26640, #26641, #26642, #26644, #26646, because their line is `QA-source: #26639 · observation N`, two fields where the contract has three.
  - **#26707 absent**: its body has no `QA-source:` line (it uses `Batch-of:`).
- The other 5 owed rows the card did not name: #23946, #23950, #24576, #24782, #24784. I spot-checked three of them, and later records hid or recorded the item not-run: `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` is hidden as blocked in #25227 and #26481, `identity-auth.email-verification-loop` is not-run in #24538, and `platform-core.shell-nav-personalization` is not-run in #24557. They are owed.
- Without `--as-of` (2026-10-29 15:41Z), there are 15 owed rows. The wave-3 records re-judged all 12 item rows above. The three `smoke:npm-18.2.0` rows stay owed until the next npm smoke. Seven new rows are wave-3 fix cards closed today: #27395, #27445, #27448, #27488, #27490, #27495, #27510.

_Keep one value on each of the two lines above, each line starting with its key.
[Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum)
item 5 says what they mean._

## Human Minimum

Each item is one rule from
[CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum),
which links the AGENTS.md text that states it.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the touched scripts.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## Acceptance notes

- **qa-rollup pagination.** `scripts/qa/qa-rollup.mjs` follows GitHub's `next` link verbatim. From a cloud session that link (`/repositories/ID/…`) answers 403 on page 2. The new reader carries the cursor onto the `/repos` path instead. Not fixed here, because it is out of scope. Carrier: the Devx seat has taken it as its own card.
- **Self-test wiring.** `retest-owed --self-test` is not run by CI, which is the same posture as `qa-rollup --self-test`. Wiring it in means a one-word addition to the `check:platform-checklist` alias, left for the seat to decide, since this card excludes CI changes.
- **Record bodies vary.** The body rule does not see judgments written as aggregate prose ("every item not listed below passed") or with short ids. Those rows come out owed, with an `unconfirmed: #N names it` pointer, so the error is on the side of re-running.
